fact: The protocol (version 4, 14 February 2026) plans to implement AI-powered chest X-ray interpretation software (Qure.ai) for women with moderate-to-severe symptoms in routine antenatal care in Guinea-Bissau, in a stepped-wedge trial.
title: Assessing the burden of tuberculosis among pregnant and postpartum women: Implications for integrating tuberculosis screening into routine antenatal care in Guinea-Bissau
publisher: Bandim Health Project / Aarhus University (PhD protocol)
